description: Declarative surface of the human review layer. 'sections' is the closed set of sections both review.json and decisions.json may carry, in the order a reader meets them; a decisions file naming anything else is rejected whole. 'drop_cap_decisions' is the closed vocabulary of the drop_caps section's values, declared here so the validator refuses an unknown verdict from the batch the section is introduced in rather than from the batch that first consumes it. 'review_format_version' stamps every exported draft, so a draft written by an older layer is recognisable rather than silently reinterpreted. 'translator_view_chars' bounds the excerpt of the text the translator was actually offered that the terms section carries beside the joined rendering a human is shown; the two differ wherever a paragraph is set in several styles, and a ruling written from the rendering cannot match the offered text, so the excerpt is what makes that disagreement visible at review time. 'matched_prompt_excerpts' bounds how many offered texts an applied ruling records per term as evidence of what it reached; the count itself is always recorded whole.
